full_judgment:
This Rule is against an order of the Assistant Judge setting aside an order passed in Miscellaneous Case instituted under section 8 of the Alienation of Land (Distressed Circumstances) (Restoration) Ordinance, 1976 (Ordinance No. XXVIII of 1976). 

 2. The petitioner filed the case for restoration of land transferred for economic distress. According to section 2(c), period of economic distress means the period commencing between April, 1974 to December 1974. In this case as the sale was effected on November 30, 1974 the transfer was during the period of economic distress. The Authorised Officer, Circle Officer (Revenue) Banshkhali on finding that the transfer was for economic distress 27.7.77 allowed the case and directed the opposite party to deliver restoration of land to the petitioners. Against that order of the Authorised Officer, the opposite party preferred Appeal No. 1 of 1987 before the Assistant Judge, Banshkhali. The learned Assistant Judge, however, on contest came to the finding that the land was not sold for economic distress as the Bainapatra for sale was executed in 1970 and the land was not an agricultural land but homestead land.
